name: ratification-session
description: A ratification session: the owner reviews decisions recorded as proposed and ratifies or sets each aside, like approving the minutes.

aiGuidance.purpose: Makes ratification a real, attributed act: one record per session, created as the human who ratified, linked by ratifies / sets-aside relations to each decision it acted on.
aiGuidance.extraction: One per session. Title 'Ratification session YYYY-MM-DD'; summary lists what was ratified and set aside.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Never created by an agent: ratification is not an agent act. Not a decision itself.
